prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 high-fashion black-and-white rainy-night street portrait of an adult man matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference. He has tousled wind-swept dark hair, light stubble, natural skin texture, and rectangular dark eyeglasses. He wears a tailored black wool coat with the collar slightly raised, leans against a wrought-iron railing on an empty wet cobblestone street, keeps one hand in a coat pocket, and looks forward with quiet confidence.
